text:
jamie: Starting a config-only rollout in the evening change window (quiet ramp). No model or runtime changes, just routing weights + batch windows + soft limits. Deploying at 2024-11-12T02:00Z.

deploy-bot: deploy request accepted · type=config-only · env=prod · owner=jamie · change_window=2024-11-12T02:00Z-03:00Z

alex: quick q — what's the canary posture? initial % and ramp schedule?

jamie: Canary 2% for 10m, then 8% for 10m, ramp to 20% over 30m if metrics stable. Quiet warmup so we avoid big traffic spikes.

maria: Key knobs: reduce batch_ms from 50 -> 25, increase primary route weight to 88%, fallback 12%, soft token limit 10% lower for 10m. Also enable tiny KV prefetch window.

alex: Rollback triggers? we should be explicit.

jamie: Rollback triggers (auto + manual):
- 95th percentile p99 latency > baseline + 200ms for 5m
- error rate delta > 0.4% absolute for 3m
- KV cache miss rate +15% sustained 5m
- any model hallucination/regression alert from QA evals (manual)

ryan: I'll watch infra dashboards and set a short alert grace to catch spikes. tagging @sara as on-call.

sara: I'm on pager for that window. I'll escalate to Jamie if we hit the first trigger.

maria: Adding the config snippet to release notes (copyable):

```yaml
kind: routing-config
owner: eng-runtime
changes: 
  - name: primary_route_weight
    from: 0.80
    to: 0.88
  - name: fallback_route_weight
    from: 0.20
    to: 0.12
  - name: batching.window_ms
    from: 50
    to: 25
  - name: soft.token_limit_pct
    from: 100
    to: 90
rollout:
  canary: [2, 8, 20]
  step_minutes: [10, 10, 30]
alerts: 
  - p95_latency_plus: 200ms
  - error_rate_delta: 0.4%
```

alex: Nice. Also add a note to pin the routing-config version in the routing policy so dedicated customers don't get the change until GA. Just config pin, not model.

jamie: Good catch. We'll publish as `routing-config@v2024-11-12-grace` and pin only for dedicated tiers. Hosted gets the canary.

deploy-bot: rollout started · routing-config@v2024-11-12-grace · canary=2% · initiated_by=jamie

ryan: Observability check: p95, p99, errors, kv-evictions, tail queuing length. I'll watch traces and open a thread if anything weird.

sara: If we hit a trigger I recommend immediate rollback to `routing-config@v2024-11-11-stable` and brief pause for postmortem.

jamie: Agreed. Fallback plan ready. If everything looks good at 40m we'll proceed to full rollout. Will post final release note blurb after GA. :white_check_mark:
